ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I selected Petrel because the query is a straightforward, benign academic writing task (synthesizing primary sources into a paragraph about civil rights history). Petrel outperforms Curlew on every relevant capability metric—Summarization (83.7 vs 80.3), Creative/Generation (85.9 vs 78.8), MMLU-Pro (80.9 vs 74.8), and IFEval (90.9 vs 85.6, important given the "one paragraph, don't ramble" formatting constraints). Since the content contains nothing harm-adjacent, Petrel's strong aversion to distasteful material is irrelevant here, leaving its superior capability as the deciding factor.
